description: List what can be booked — the staff, rooms, tables or assets in the company directory. A resource is whatever can only be in one place at a time, and it is shared across services: the same barber is one resource whether he cuts hair or trims a beard, which is why booking him for one closes the other. Read this before creating anything and reuse what is there.
name: hub_get_booking_resources
title: List booking resources
